name: Typefully
tagline: Write, schedule, and analyze Twitter threads
verdictSummary: A tweet composer with thread preview and scheduling is a single-page app. OpenAI API integration for AI-assisted writing. Schedule via X API or just store drafts.
coreLoopDIY: Thread editor with preview and AI assistance
whyPeopleStillPay: Convenience and analytics for professional Twitter creators
